features.title: Direction-aware bounded dash
features.gap: Inspected TryDash adds fixed positive Y rather than intended movement direction.
features.adaptation: Dash in a normalized desired direction with a deterministic neutral-input fallback, preserving world bounds and existing resource/cooldown semantics.
touchpoints: Game entry point and matching tests: resolve exact files before editing
dependencies: Confirm coordinate/input contract and engine-worker ownership
Native input acceptance for playable integration
acceptance: Cardinal/diagonal distances agree; zero/nonfinite direction is handled safely
No boundary escape, duplicate cost or cooldown bypass
Actual input path produces the intended movement

features.title: Timed dodge and counter opportunity
features.gap: Inspected dash/guard code has no incoming-hit timing or earned counter state; verify other modules before adding.
features.adaptation: An original attack timeline and bounded evasion window grant one earned counter opportunity, not unlimited invulnerability.
touchpoints: Game-specific enemy attack state and corresponding tests
dependencies: Incoming enemy attack and player-damage contract
Owned input integration and native acceptance
acceptance: Early/inside/late timing cases produce distinct correct results
A hit event cannot be negated or rewarded twice
Expired counters cannot trigger; event order is deterministic

features.title: Stagger and recovery states
features.gap: Inspected training dummy tracks health only, without posture/stagger.
features.adaptation: Add bounded posture accumulation, a brief vulnerable state and recovery with readable feedback.
touchpoints: Matching domain tests; HUD integration requires shared-path coordination
acceptance: Threshold crossing occurs once and values stay bounded
Defeat overrides stagger; expiry/recovery is deterministic
No permanent stun lock from duplicated events

features.title: Contextual follow-up attack
features.gap: Inspected Fatal Strike is resource/cooldown gated but not linked to an earned vulnerability window.
features.adaptation: A single-protagonist follow-up consumes one stagger opening; no forced party-switch redesign.
touchpoints: Matching tests and existing input feedback
acceptance: Opening is consumed once and expires predictably
Invalid, defeated or out-of-range targets do not spend resources
Ordinary attacks remain available under their existing rules

features.title: Landmark objective sequence
features.gap: Inspected encounter is a small discover-activate-defeat-reward flow, not a reusable objective journal.
features.adaptation: An original National Mall objective sequence with explicit next-action feedback and idempotent completion.
dependencies: Agree stable objective IDs and game-data ownership
Persistence interface before claiming cross-session completion
acceptance: Ordered and out-of-order interactions are handled explicitly
Completion/reward is idempotent across repeated events
Displayed next objective agrees with authoritative state

features.title: Dialogue acknowledges player choices
features.gap: No dialogue branching is visible in the inspected combat/landmark modules; search the full live tree before creating a subsystem.
features.adaptation: A bounded authored conversation gives choice-specific responses, remembers asked questions and cannot regrant quest rewards.
touchpoints: Game-specific dialogue data/state: proposed, not existing
Objective integration and tests; UI is a coordinated dependency
dependencies: Native UI acceptance before claiming a playable conversation
acceptance: Two distinct choices reach different appropriate response IDs
Already-asked questions do not loop unexpectedly
Repeated/reloaded completion cannot duplicate a reward
